content: Hessafe guye, kahine halaqay Iyyasuy Godaa kiitanchuwa sinthan eqidaysanne xalahey Iyyasu mootanaw iyape ushacha baggara eqidaysa tana qoncethan bessis.
Goday, “Xalahiyaw, Goday nena seero; Yerusalaame doorida Goday nena seero! Ha addey tamape attida duncha mela gidennee?” yaagis.
Iyyasuy qitatida ma7o ma77idi kiitanchuwa sinthan eqis.
Kiitanchoy ba sinthan eqidaysata, “Iya bollafe ha qita ma7uwa qaarite” yaagis. Qassi Iyyasuko, “Heko, taani ne nagara neepe diggas; boncho ma7uwa nena mayzana.”
Taani, “Geeshsha xaatha qaciya iya huuphen xaaxite” yaagis. Enti kiittidaysada oothidosona; ma7o mayzidosona. Godaa kiitanchoy he wode iya miyen eqis.

Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday haysada yaagees; “Neeni ta ogiyan hemetikonne ta kiita naagiko, neeni ta keethaa aysana; ta dabaaban aawatana. Qassi haysan eqidaysatara issife geliyanne keyiya maata new immana.
Kahine halaqa Iyyasu, haysa si7a! Sinthara yaana lo77obaas malaata gididaysatinne neera ootheysati haysa si7o! Taani, ‘Tashe’ geetetiya ta aylliya ehana.

Heko, taani Iyyasu sinthan shuchu wothana; he shucha bolla laapun ayfeti de7oosona. Taani he shuchaa woocada iya bolla xuufe xaafana; ha biitta nagara issi gallas diggana” yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.
“He gallas hinte ubbay hinte woynenne hinte balase garsan uttidi hinte shooruwa xeegana” yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.
